decisions.statement: A command line has several calls.
Judging stops at the first refusal.
A line with no call of any kind is refused for nothing.
A hook judging each call the hook cuts the same way binds this module rather than spelling the loop.
Nothing here defines a call or a reason to refuse a call.
A hook hands in the calls the hook cut and the judgement the hook makes.
A hook is handed back the one refusal or no refusal.

definition: one refusal representing the whole command line it was found in
